description: Read which voice stack answers the AI tier: livekit or elevenlabs (the ElevenLabs Agents platform running the same receptionist brain; a caller who needs a person is still transferred to the business's team number or a message is taken). The server chooses the initial stack based on provider availability. Shows desired vs applied, status ok | pending | error, the steps of the last switch and lastError.

businessId.description: Defaults to the business of the API key in the Authorization header.
